subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `skills.load` source opt-out for `agents-skills-personal`, and should that API be a typed source-disable list or a narrower personal-source toggle?
rationale: The source-level behavior is currently a built-in cross-agent convention, and adding an opt-out expands public config surface that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Approve typed source-disable list
options.body: Add a documented `skills.load.disableSources`-style enum list and apply it before discovery, watcher registration, status, and prompt snapshot generation.

options.title: Approve personal-source toggle only
options.body: Add the narrowest possible boolean for the home `.agents/skills` root, reducing API breadth but likely requiring another design pass if project-agent sources need the same treatment later.

options.title: Decline source opt-out
options.body: Keep the current agentskills convention as always-on and direct users to per-skill disables, prompt limits, or moving Claude Code skills out of the shared directory.

recommendation.title: Approve typed source-disable list
recommendation.body: Add a documented `skills.load.disableSources`-style enum list and apply it before discovery, watcher registration, status, and prompt snapshot generation.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the heaviest recent history on the skills loader and watcher surface and is the strongest routing candidate for the config/product decision.
